boundary: Streaming chat completions, temperature 0, low reasoning effort, fixed output length, explicit cache flush, and cache-busted Federalist prose. Cells: about 131K input at concurrency 1 and 16; about 410K at concurrency 8; about 524K at concurrency 16 (2,048 output tokens); about 1M at concurrency 1 and 4 (512 output tokens). Full-request output rates published only for the concurrency-1 cells. Concurrent aggregate throughput, decode TPOT, and ITL are excluded because the retained clocks do not support them.
campaign: Audited serving envelope: six cells, three repetitions each

environment.gpu_visibility: replica A GPUs 0-3, replica B GPUs 4-7
environment.ingress: loopback nginx with session-affine consistent hash on x-claude-code-session-id

evidence_class: sanitized request-level records published under results/serving-envelope/raw/

method.rate_rule: output tokens divided by full request wall time, including prefill
method.success_rule: HTTP 200, integrity pass, and the exact requested completion length; timeouts and HTTP 429 stay in the denominator
